key_insight: This work builds a large spin-polarized database of halide double perovskites, revealing substantial electronic and magnetic diversity, including many visible-band-gap and half-metallic candidates.
engineering_relevance: The dataset accelerates screening of perovskites for photovoltaics, spintronics, photocatalysis, and radiation detection by linking composition to electronic structure and bonding.
method: Spin-polarized density of states computed across X = I, Br, Cl, F
LOBSTER bonding analysis plus UMAP visualization and interactive app
evidence_signal: The abstract reports >2,500 compounds, with 719 visible-range band gaps and 118 half-metallic materials, all supported by DOS and bonding analysis.
watch_item: Predictions depend on DFT-based stability screening and computed structures, so experimental synthesis and finite-temperature effects may differ from the database trends.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
